comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
R8 Sewing recipe available during World Clock 15th century Phases 2 and 3. Recipe is found at the Spectating Girl (Marseilles Square). Unisex hat, +1 Procurement, 500 total fame required to equip. Ingredients are:

10 Leather
20 Knitted Fabric
10 Embroidery Thread
